2608.24334.title: SeMoCo: A Semantic-First Motion Codec for Motion Language Modeling
2608.24334.paper_summary: Discrete motion representations have substantially advanced autoregressive text-to-motion generation. However, most motion tokenizers are optimized for reconstruction and do not explicitly allocate capacity according to semantic role. Action-level meaning and fine-grained kinematic detail must therefore be encoded through the same reconstruction-driven hierarchy. We introduce SeMoCo, a semantic-first motion codec, together with a dual-axis motion generator for language-conditioned motion generation. Each motion token contains one semantic token and a residual sequence of kinematic tokens. The generator models semantic progression across time and autoregressively refines the residual entries. We also construct $Ω$-MotionVerse, a large-scale, multi-source human-motion dataset unified under the SOMA representation. Across the reported comparisons, SeMoCo achieves the best reconstruction accuracy among the compared codecs, while strong text-to-motion results demonstrate the effectiveness of its motion tokens for downstream generation.
2608.24334.paper_summary_zh: 離散運動表示法在自回歸文本到運動生成方面有了顯著的進展。<lb/>然而，大多數運動標記器是針對重建進行優化的，並未明確根據語義角色分配容量。<lb/>因此，行動層級的意義和細緻的運動學細節必須通過相同的重建驅動層級進行編碼。<lb/>我們介紹了SeMoCo，一種以語義為先的運動編碼器，以及一個雙軸運動生成器，用於基於語言的運動生成。<lb/>每個運動標記包含一個語義標記和一個運動學標記的殘差序列。<lb/>生成器在時間上建模語義進展，並自回歸地細化殘差條目。<lb/>我們還構建了$Ω$-MotionVerse，一個大型的多來源人類運動數據集，統一在SOMA表示下。<lb/>在報告的比較中，SeMoCo在比較的編碼器中達到了最佳的重建準確性，而強大的文本到運動結果則展示了其運動標記在下游生成中的有效性。
